metaDescription: Customizable 3D-printed competition shooting belts, attachments, free open-source designs, assembly videos, and SplitShot software from Klock Holding Co.
heroHeading: Built for shooters who want it their way.
heroText: Klock Holding Co. is my one-man shop making customizable belts, attachments, and 3D-printed accessories for competitive shooters. All STL files are open sourced; finished gear is available for the people who would rather buy than build.
